# Privo API

> Privo is a privacy-first URL shortener at https://privo.fyi. This file is the
> complete API reference for agents. Machine-readable spec:
> https://privo.fyi/openapi.json — human docs: https://privo.fyi/docs

Base URL: `https://privo.fyi`. All responses are JSON. Errors are always
`{"error": "message"}`; a 422 caused by a Web Risk flag also carries
`"threats": [...]`. No CORS headers — call it server-side. No rate limits or
429s today. Unversioned; additive changes only.

## Authentication

Send `Authorization: Bearer pv_…` on requests that need it. Keys are created
in Privo Cloud → API Keys (https://privo.fyi/cloud/app/api.html) — NOT via the
API, so a leaked key can't mint more. Scopes chosen at creation:

- `links:read` — read links on privo.fyi and your verified custom domains
- `links:write` — create and edit links on privo.fyi
- `links:custom` — create, edit, and read links on your verified custom domains

Test a key: `GET /api/me` → `{"user": {"email": "…", "name": "…", "picture": "…"}}`

## Endpoints

### POST /api/link — create a short link

Body (JSON):
- `url` (required): http(s) destination
- `shortcode`: optional custom code, 4–45 ASCII letters/digits, case-sensitive,
  stored verbatim. Reserved on privo.fyi (→ 409): about, terms, privacy, stop,
  report, login, admin, cloud, assets, api, legal, auth, me, docs.
- `domain`: body field, defaults to `privo.fyi`. Custom domain must be verified
  on your account and needs `links:custom`.
- `seo`: optional object `{title, description, siteName, image}` overriding the
  destination's preview metadata. Limits: title 200, description 1000,
  siteName 100, image 2048 chars and must be an http(s) URL.

Anonymous creation (no key) is allowed but the link can never be edited.
Not idempotent — retry only with an explicit `shortcode` (a duplicate → 409,
not a second link).

201 → `{"shortcode", "shortUrl", "originalUrl", "safety", "preview"}` where
`safety` ∈ `clean|flagged|unchecked` and `preview` is
`{title, description, image, siteName}` (nullable fields; may be null briefly
while metadata is fetched).

### GET /api/link/{shortcode}?domain={domain} — read a link

Public for privo.fyi (no key). For a custom domain the key needs
`links:read` or `links:custom` and ownership of the domain.
200 → `{"shortcode", "url", "createdAt", "shortUrl", "preview"}`.
`createdAt` is UTC `"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"`.

### GET|PUT /api/cloud/link/{shortcode}?domain={domain} — owner view / update

Requires auth; the link must be owned by your account. Scope needed:
`links:write` (privo.fyi) or `links:custom` (custom domain).

GET → `{"shortcode", "shortLink", "url", "title", "description", "image", "siteName"}`.

PUT is a FULL update, not a merge: `url` and `seo` are BOTH required — send
`"seo": {}` for no overrides. Any seo field you omit is re-fetched from the
new destination's metadata; previous preview values are not preserved. The new
destination is safety-checked again. Response: same shape as GET.

### GET /api/check?url={encoded} — destination safety check

Public. Same check that runs before every redirect.
200 → `{"status": "clean|flagged|unchecked", "threats": [...]}`.
`threats` values: `MALWARE`, `SOCIAL_ENGINEERING`, `UNWANTED_SOFTWARE`,
`BLOCKLIST`.

## Errors

| Status | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| 400 | Bad request — invalid URL, shortcode, or JSON. `{"error": "Invalid URL provided"}` |
| 401 | No valid key/session. `{"error": "Sign in or send an API key."}` |
| 403 | Authenticated but not allowed — missing scope, unverified domain, account limit |
| 404 | No such link on that domain (or not yours) |
| 409 | Shortcode taken or reserved |
| 422 | Destination blocked/flagged. `{"error": "…", "threats": ["MALWARE"]}` (threats only on Web Risk flags) |
| 500 | Server error |

## Notes

- There is NO endpoint that lists an account's links. Don't guess one; the
  links list is a session-only Privo Cloud view.
- The `domain` parameter is a JSON body field on POST /api/link but a query
  parameter on GET /api/link/{shortcode} and GET|PUT /api/cloud/link/{shortcode}.
- Key management (create/revoke, max 20 active) is UI-only in Privo Cloud.

## Quickstart

```bash
KEY=pv_your_key_here

# verify the key
curl -s https://privo.fyi/api/me -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"

# create a link
curl -s https://privo.fyi/api/link -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"url": "https://example.com/article", "shortcode": "myarticle"}'

# read it back (public on privo.fyi)
curl -s https://privo.fyi/api/link/myarticle

# update it (seo is required; {} means no overrides)
curl -s "https://privo.fyi/api/cloud/link/myarticle" -X PUT \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"url": "https://example.com/new-article", "seo": {}}'
```
